scenarios.name: dredge-four-replaces-draw-at-boundary
scenarios.why: With at least four cards in the library and Golgari Thug in the graveyard, its controller may mill exactly four and return the Thug to hand instead of drawing.

scenarios.name: not-in-graveyard-does-not-replace-draw
scenarios.why: Dredge works only from the graveyard. With Golgari Thug in hand, the draw happens normally and the Thug remains there.
